knowledge_gaps: Training-prefix targets were potentially observed during model fitting. Removing a target from diagnostic input does not make it held out. These measurements must be labeled in-sample diagnostics and cannot establish generalization.

Recent-suffix deletion changes the final observed item, whereas older-prefix deletion preserves it. Their difference therefore mixes recency, last-item identity and sequence context. Add controls that preserve the final item while removing recent versus older preceding interactions.

The protocol lacks reproducible prefix counts, deletion sizes, shuffle repetitions, candidate sampling and exclusion rules, tie handling, subgroup boundaries and computation limits. Uncertainty estimation must distinguish user sampling from perturbation randomness.

Padding checks require an explicit tolerance and supported sequence lengths. Unpadded execution may need an adapter when ModelView expects fixed-length inputs. Any recurrent correction requires retraining and identical predictor changes before interpreting the resulting model.

The originality rating is reasonable for an integration of established methods, but potential 8/10 is speculative without evidence that these diagnostics guide validation improvements. Difficulty 4/10 may underestimate interface verification, padding corrections and ranking computation. Simpler last-item and truncation controls should precede extensive probes.
